title: Job configuration
description: The merged configuration of one job: run inputs, then `Site settings`, then the profile's `defaults`, then the defaults of this schema. The root is the merged form (every field present). `$defs/job_settings` is one unmerged layer (every field optional, `null`/""/[]/{} = not set). Requests are validated strictly: unknown fields are refused.

site_url.description: Start URL. Required unless `discovery_mode` is `url_list`. Its host must not resolve to a private, loopback or link-local address. Defines the job's `site`.

extraction_instructions.description: What to extract, in words. Not used by the crawler; stored with the job and passed back in mapping requests for the mapping agent.

fields.description: Fields the mapping agent is asked to map. A record carries the fields of its template's mapping (`build_mapping` maps every name listed here).

ai_choose_fields.description: Added 2026-11-14. Let the mapping agent choose the fields the sample pages really carry (beyond `fields`, guided by `fields_hint`); passed to it in mapping requests. `fields` stays the explicit way.

fields_hint.description: Added 2026-11-14. A hint for `ai_choose_fields`, e.g. "wine: vintage, type, bottle size, taste".

required_fields.description: Fields a record must have. At run time a page is `incomplete` when a field in `required_fields` or a mapping field with `required: true` is empty (a name missing from the mapping is always empty). Default: `["title"]` when `fields` contains `title`, otherwise the first entry of `fields`.

discovery_mode.description: How URLs are found. See the README for the `auto` rule.

max_records.description: Stop fetching as soon as this many distinct records are extracted; pages in progress are finished. `null` = no limit.

url_include.description: Regular expressions (Python `re` syntax, searched anywhere in the canonical URL). When non-empty a discovered URL is queued only if one matches.

url_exclude.description: Regular expressions; a discovered URL that matches one is never queued. Applied after `url_include`.

crawl_include.description: Added 2026-11-14 — where to walk. Regular expressions searched in the canonical URL: a page's links are followed only when the page matches one (the start page always); empty = the whole site. Links leaving the scope are queued only when they look like target pages (`url_include`, a mapping's `url_patterns`, URL shapes of pages already found to be targets) — or every link of a walked page when no target can be told by URL yet. `url_include` stays what to extract, `url_exclude` what never to fetch.

stay_in_section.description: Added 2026-11-14. Walk only the start page's section: its URL and everything below its path (the start URL's pagination included); added to `crawl_include`. No effect on a site root.

link_rules_off.description: Added 2026-11-14. Link rules switched off for this run (README 4.11): `scheme`, `messenger_social`, `sensitive_path`, `action_params`, `file_extension`, `nofollow`, `facet_params`, `trap_budget`, `dynamic_params`, `canonical`. Empty = every rule on. Example: `["facet_params"]` follows filter links.

trap_pattern_budget.description: Added 2026-11-14. Trap budget: a URL pattern (first path segment, and query names) whose last N pages reached by links were no target page and led to no new target page stops being followed. 0 = off.

urls.description: The pages to scrape in `url_list` mode, with the caller's optional row key. Ignored in other modes (warning `invalid_value`).

sitemap_url.description: Explicit sitemap or sitemap index (XML, text, gzip). `null` = from robots.txt, then `/sitemap.xml`.

target_page_selector.description: CSS selector present only on target pages. Used to recognise target pages that no template matches (`no_template`) and as the default `match.selector` for a new template.

max_pages.description: Every fetched page counts, listing pages included. Reaching it stops fetching (`stop_reason: max_pages`).

fetch_mode.description: `auto` lets the service choose HTTP or browser per page.

browser.description: Browser for browser fetches. `auto` = Camoufox when the image has it, otherwise Chromium. A browser missing from the image is refused (`browser_not_available`).

browser_os.description: Added 2026-11-13; default `host` since 2026-11-13. Camoufox: the OS of the browser identity — `host` = the machine's own OS (Linux in the image), `windows`, `macos`, `linux`. On a test managed challenge only the host-OS identity passed. Part of the identity key: each value gets its own fingerprint per exit. Chromium always claims the host OS.

canvas_noise.description: Added 2026-11-13. Camoufox only: `auto` = Camoufox's own rule (a `windows`/`macos` identity on the Linux image has its canvas and WebGL readback replaced with random data, as in Tor Browser), `off` = the page reads the host's real pixels, `on` = always random. Part of the identity key. `protection_trace[].environment.canvas_readback` shows the effect. Chromium ignores it.

use_proxy_tiers.description: Which of the profile's proxy tiers this job may use; `[]` = every configured tier. Called `proxy_tiers` in the task document's `Site settings`; renamed so that `proxy_tiers` means only the profile's tier list.

challenge_click.description: Request the checkbox click (route step `click`). Ignored with warning `challenge_click_not_allowed` when the service does not allow it.

use_solver.description: Request the solver (route step `solver`). Ignored with warning `solver_not_allowed` when the service does not allow solvers; refused with `solver_not_configured` when the profile has no solver.

delay_min_seconds.description: Lower bound of the random delay between two requests to the same host. Since 2026-11-14 the default comes from `politeness` (the value shown is `normal`'s); a value set in a layer wins.

delay_max_seconds.description: Upper bound of that delay. Since 2026-11-14 the default comes from `politeness` (the value shown is `normal`'s); a value set in a layer wins.

max_concurrency.description: Pages in progress at once. Browser crawls start at 1 and scale up to this. Since 2026-11-14 the default comes from `politeness` (the value shown is `normal`'s); a value set in a layer wins.

max_requests_per_minute.description: Requests per minute for the whole job. Since 2026-11-14 the default comes from `politeness` (the value shown is `normal`'s); a value set in a layer wins.

max_retries.description: Retries of one page after a fetch failure (blocks are handled by the protection route, not by retries).

block_heavy_resources.description: Browser fetches skip images, media and fonts.

extraction_mode.description: Which mapping sources are used: `structured_data` = only `jsonld` sources, `selectors` = only `css` and `meta`, `auto` = all, in mapping order.

structured_data_types.description: JSON-LD `@type` values considered when recognising target pages and returned in samples.

wait_after_load_ms.description: Extra wait after a browser page has loaded.

wait_for_selector_ms.description: How long a browser fetch waits for the template's `match.selector` (or `target_page_selector`) before extracting anyway.

headers.description: Extra request headers. `Authorization`, `Proxy-Authorization`, `Cookie`, `Host`, `Content-Length` and `Transfer-Encoding` are refused (`header_not_allowed`).

respect_robots.description: Honour robots.txt. `false` is ignored with warning `robots_override_not_allowed` unless the service allows an override.

rebuild_mapping.description: Read by the `Scrape a site` workflow only (build a new mapping even when a stored one passes). Stored, never acted on by the service.

debug.description: Verbose job log entries in `errors[]` with severity `debug`.

sample_count.description: Target pages fetched by `POST /v1/samples` and attached to a mapping request.

required_fill_threshold.description: Share of pages of one template on which every required field must be filled. Used by `POST /v1/mappings/test` (pass flag) and by the repair trigger.

max_refinements.description: Read by `build_mapping` only (refinements after the first generation). Stored, never acted on by the service.

max_repairs_per_template.description: Mapping requests per template and job; when spent the template is marked `failed`.

max_repairs_per_job.description: Mapping requests per job, all templates together (new templates included).

max_duration_minutes.description: Time in `running` (time in `queued` and `waiting_for_credentials` does not count). Reaching it stops fetching (`stop_reason: max_duration`).

politeness.description: Added 2026-11-14. A preset for the politeness fields not set in any layer: `gentle` = delay 5–10 s, `max_concurrency` 1, `max_requests_per_minute` 10, `page_timeout_seconds` 120; `normal` = 2–5 s, 2, 30, 60; `fast` = 0.5–1.5 s, 4, 120, 30. A field set explicitly wins; robots.txt `Crawl-delay` is always the floor; the automatic slow-down never goes faster than these values (README 4.15).

page_timeout_seconds.description: Added 2026-11-14. How long one page may take: the HTTP request and the browser navigation of a run, and the fetches of `POST /v1/analyze` and `POST /v1/samples`. Default from `politeness` (`normal`: 60).

when_site_busy.description: Added 2026-11-14. `POST /v1/runs` while a run of the same site is queued, running or stopping: `skip` (default) refuses the start with `409 site_busy` and stores nothing; `queue` stores the run and starts it when the other one ends (README 4.13).

max_sitemap_entries.description: Maximum raw page locations enumerated by the run sitemap feeder, before url_include/url_exclude. Filtered locations and changed-source replays spend this budget; restarts do not reset it. Capped by limits.max_sitemap_entries. Auto inspection, analysis and samples retain separate smaller preview limits; source files remain capped at 500.

sitemap_source_include.description: Optional child sitemap source URL regexes, searched in canonical URLs. Empty means all discovered child sources. Active declared roots are always read. Every intermediate index must also match; excluding an index excludes its descendants. This declares source scope, not complete website coverage.

sitemap_source_exclude.description: Child sitemap source URL regexes never fetched, applied after sitemap_source_include. Active declared roots are always read. Explicit exclusions narrow declared source coverage; filenames are never automatically discarded.

job_settings.description: One unmerged layer: run inputs, `Site settings` or the profile's `defaults`. A missing field, `null`, an empty string, an empty array and an empty object all mean "not set in this layer".

unset.description: "Not set in this layer": null, an empty string, an empty array or an empty object.

resolved_discovery_mode.description: A discovery mode after `auto` was decided.

browser_name.description: A concrete browser of the image.

regex.description: Python `re` syntax; an invalid pattern is refused with `pattern_invalid`.

key.description: The caller's own row id (an article number); copied into the record as `source_key`.

validate_request.description: Body of `POST /v1/config/validate`. Layers are merged in this order: `run_inputs`, `site_settings`, `profile.defaults`, schema defaults.

validate_response.description: Response of `POST /v1/config/validate` (always 200 for a well-formed request). `config` is the merged configuration, `null` when `valid` is false.

sources.description: For each field of `config`: which layer supplied the value.

service_limits.description: The service's configured hard limits. Each value is at most the contract ceiling given as `maximum`.

max_result_bytes.description: A job stops with `stop_reason: max_result_size` before its result file would exceed this (default 99 MiB, just under the platform's 100 MiB artifact upload cap).

max_concurrent_jobs.description: Jobs in `running` at once; further jobs wait in `queued`.

max_queued_jobs.description: Jobs in `queued`; a start beyond this is refused with `queue_full`.

max_url_list_entries.description: Upper bound for the length of `urls`.

max_sample_count.description: Upper bound for `sample_count` and for `urls` in a samples request.

max_stored_pages_per_job.description: Pages kept as fetched for re-extraction; beyond it only the URL is kept and the page is fetched again after the repair.

max_request_body_bytes.description: Largest accepted request body; larger bodies get `request_too_large`.

max_templates_per_site.description: Templates with an active mapping per site.

max_fields_per_template.description: Fields in one template mapping and in `fields`.

sample_html_max_bytes.description: Size of `distilled_html` per sample; longer content is cut and `distilled_html_truncated` is true.

max_sitemap_entries.description: Service upper bound for the raw max_sitemap_entries request; WSS_LIMIT_MAX_SITEMAP_ENTRIES may lower it. The request default remains 100000.

steps_allowed.description: Route steps this service may use: the always-on steps, plus `click` / `solver` when allowed, minus browsers missing from the image.

solver_providers.description: Providers with an adapter in this build.

stall_seconds.description: Added 2026-11-14. No progress this long: a `stalled` problem; twice as long: the run stops `stalled`. 0 = off (`WSS_STALL_SECONDS`).

undecryptable_jobs.description: Jobs whose stored secrets the current key cannot open.

browser_os.description: Added 2026-11-13. The OS a Camoufox identity claims; `host` = the machine's own OS (Linux in the image).

canvas_noise.description: Added 2026-11-13. Camoufox canvas readback: `auto` = Camoufox's own rule (covered with random data when the identity claims another OS or GPU than the host renders with), `off` = never covered, `on` = always covered.
